set.body: VersionedCodec.decode accepts exactly one schema id (codec/VersionedCodec.scala:145), so the first v2 of any schema strands saved projects. Add an upcast registry (vN->vN+1 total functions, law: decode(upcast(old)) == decode(new)), pinned old fixtures per schema. Pick one artifact-identity scheme: ContentHash is 64-bit FNV-1a (ArtifactRef) while manifests use SHA-256; either SHA-256 everywhere artifacts are persisted or state FNV's scope in the type. Canonical wire forms (e.g. sorted sets rejected/canonicalised on decode).
set.title: CR3: schema upcasting and one artifact identity
